title: TikTok U.S. hunts for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity, sources tell CNBC
summary: TikTok's U.S. division is actively exploring various avenues to secure substantial computing capacity in the coming years. This initiative reflects the growing demand for computational resources as the platform continues to expand its services. The search for gigawatts of computing power highlights the importance of infrastructure in sustaining the rapid growth of social media platforms like TikTok.
